description: Lists recent deliveries of one webhook endpoint, newest first: event, result, HTTP status, attempts and time. Use when the user asks why a webhook failed, whether events arrived, or what was sent recently. Not for sending a test (use test_webhook). Returns deliveries without payload bodies.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook endpoint. Get it from list_webhooks.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
